h1: AI Product Videos for Electronics, From the Box to Daily Use
lead: Show the gadget in a hand. A product link or one clear photo can become an unboxing, a setup, or a desk scene, with a voiceover and captions.
card: Unboxings, setups, and everyday-carry scenes from one gadget photo.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot before I can make an electronics clip?
faq.a: No. Upload one photo or paste a product link, name the action, and download a 6, 10, 15, or 30 second clip. Credits are 24, 40, 60, and 120. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Do I need video editing experience?
faq.a: No. Voice and captions come with the clip, and you can fix them in the editor on the same page. Prices, specs, and any licensed music you add stay where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I make several cuts of the same gadget?
faq.a: Yes. One photo can become an unboxing, a setup, and a travel scene. Check shape and ports on every cut before you test them in an ad account.

faq.q: Which electronics can I show from one photo?
faq.a: Speakers, headphones, chargers, stands, phone cases, and other gadgets with a clear shape. Use that product's own photo, and name one action, such as a button press or an unboxing.

faq.q: Can I make an electronics clip without hiring a creator?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one product photo or paste a link, pick a generated presenter, and pay the credits shown before the job. Post the clip as an ad, not as a customer's review.

faq.q: Will the clip state my battery life or wattage?
faq.a: Do not rely on the picture for specs. Add battery, wattage, and compatibility yourself in the listing or your editor, where you can check the numbers.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid gadget ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use, including paid ads. Keep performance claims accurate.
Video frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. A vertical 9:16 fits a phone feed. A 16:9 fits a wider product page.

faq.q: Can the gadget clip include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a generated presenter and the clip can include a spoken line and captions. Specs still belong in your listing, where you can check the numbers.
